qualificationLimits: Agency backward/forward compatibility requires the retained identity, ACP1/close, restricted configuration and tool/terminal contract; not every historical or future version.

Generated PCM and native dependency checks do not establish recognition quality, a clean VM, hardware-wide behavior or real installed speech operation.
